a2-u5-l1#nemas-chut-ist-zajtra.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Tomáš, a pair of ice skates slung over his shoulder, phones cheerfully from a snowy street. Right: in the dorm room, Emma, in bed with a blanket round her and a box of tissues beside her, answers, looking miserable.

a2-u5-l1#mam-nadchu.picture: Emma, wrapped in a blanket at her desk in the dorm room, blows her red nose into a tissue; crumpled tissues pile up beside her.

a2-u5-l1#kaslem.picture: Emma, sitting up in bed in the dorm room, coughs hard into her elbow, her eyes screwed shut.

a2-u5-l2#vyzeras-zle.picture: Lucia, just home, her bag still on her shoulder, stops in the doorway of the dorm room and looks at Emma with concern: Emma, huddled on her bed in a blanket, is pale as a sheet, with dark rings under her eyes.

a2-u5-l2#teplota.picture: In the dorm room, Emma, sitting up in bed, squints at the thermometer she has just taken from under her arm; Lucia leans over to look too.

a2-u5-l3#sestricka.picture: At the doctor's surgery, the nurse opens the door of the consulting room and calls in the next patient; in the waiting room, Emma, wrapped in her scarf, gets up from her chair.

a2-u5-l3#preukaz-poistenca.picture: At the nurse's desk in the doctor's surgery, Emma hands over her blue European health insurance card; the nurse holds out her hand for it, smiling.

a2-u5-l3#cakaren.picture: The waiting room of the doctor's surgery: chairs along the walls, a coat stand, a window. The pensioner waits with his stick, a young mother holds a coughing toddler on her knee, and Emma, in her scarf, sniffles into a tissue.

a2-u5-l4#dychajte-zhlboka.picture: In the doctor's surgery, Emma sits on the edge of the examination couch in her white T-shirt and takes a deep breath, eyes closed; the doctor listens to her back through her stethoscope.

a2-u5-l4#ukazte-mi-hrdlo.picture: In the doctor's surgery, Emma opens her mouth wide to say ah; the doctor, holding a wooden spatula, shines a small torch into her throat.

a2-u5-l4#pite-vela-tekutin.picture: Emma, in bed in the dorm room, drinks a big glass of water; on her bedside table stand a full jug of water, a teapot and a bottle of juice.

a2-u5-l5#lekarnicka.picture: A pharmacy: shelves of medicine boxes and a glass cabinet behind the counter. The pharmacist takes Emma's prescription across the counter and reads it over her half-moon glasses.

a2-u5-l5#tabletka.picture: Close up at Emma's desk: Emma presses a small white tablet out of a blister strip into her palm; the opened pack and a glass of water stand beside it.

a2-u5-l5#trikrat-denne.picture: Three small scenes of one day, side by side, in the dorm room: in the morning, the sun rising in the window; at midday, the sun high; at night, the moon in the window. Each time Emma takes a tablet with a glass of water.

a2-u5-l6#kvapky-do-nosa.picture: At the mirror in the dorm bathroom, Emma tips her head back and squeezes drops from a small bottle into her nose.

a2-u5-l6#co-mi-odporucate.picture: At the pharmacy counter, Emma, sniffling, asks the pharmacist's advice; the pharmacist holds up a bottle of cough syrup, recommending it.

a2-u5-l6#nechaj-tak-ja-to.picture: At the pharmacy counter, Emma, a big jar of vitamins in her hand, winces as she looks into her nearly empty purse; Lucia, beside her, waves Emma's purse away and holds her own card to the card reader, while the pharmacist smiles.

a2-u5-l7#zlomil-som-si-ruku.picture: On a snowy ski slope in the mountains, Marek sits in the snow after a fall, his skis tangled, clutching his arm and wincing with pain; Tomáš skids to a stop beside him.

a2-u5-l7#zavolaj-sanitku.picture: On the ski slope, Tomáš kneels in the snow beside Marek, who lies holding his arm, and phones urgently for an ambulance; other skiers stop to look.

a2-u5-l7#nemocnica.picture: An ambulance with its blue lights flashing pulls up at the A&E entrance of a big hospital; paramedics help Marek out, his arm strapped to his chest, and Tomáš follows. Through the glass doors: a waiting area with rows of plastic chairs.

a2-u5-l8#kde-vas-boli.picture: In the hospital's bright treatment room, Veronika asks Marek gently where it hurts; Marek, sitting on the couch, points to his forearm, wincing.

a2-u5-l8#zlomenina.picture: In the hospital's treatment room, Veronika points to the X-ray of Marek's forearm on the screen, where the bone is clearly broken; Marek stares at it in dismay.

a2-u5-l8#sadra.picture: In the hospital's treatment room, Veronika smooths the last of a white plaster cast round Marek's arm, from his hand to his elbow, and wags a finger at him with a smile as he protests that he has to get back to work.

a2-u5-l8#byt-na-pn-ke.picture: A weekday morning in Marek's living room: Marek, his arm in plaster, slumps on the sofa in his red flannel shirt, scowling and bored, a cookery show on the TV.

a2-u5-l9#hlava-a-krk.picture: At his laptop in his untidy office, Tomáš tilts his head to one side and rubs the back of his stiff neck.

a2-u5-l9#rameno-a-ruka.picture: In Marek's living room, Marek shows Lucia where it hurts: he touches his shoulder with his good hand; his other arm, in a white plaster cast, rests in a sling.

a2-u5-l9#chrbat-a-brucho.picture: Two halves. Left: Tomáš, stiff after the skiing trip, bends forward with a hand pressed to his aching back. Right: Lucia curls up on the sofa clutching her stomach, a half-eaten box of chocolates beside her.

a2-u5-l9#srdce.picture: In a hospital corridor, Marek, his arm in plaster, presses his good hand to his heart and gazes dreamily after Veronika as she walks away.

a2-u5-l10#tvar.picture: A close-up of Veronika's face at the hospital, smiling warmly.

a2-u5-l10#oci-a-usi.picture: In the Šimkos' living room, Samko pulls a funny face at Lucia: he pulls his ears out to the sides with his fingers and opens his eyes as wide as they will go; Lucia laughs.

a2-u5-l10#nos-a-usta.picture: In the snowy front garden of the Šimkos' house, Samko finishes a snowman's face: he pushes in a carrot for its nose and a curved row of small pebbles for its smiling mouth.

a2-u5-l11#zubar.picture: At the dentist's: Emma lies back in the big dentist's chair with her mouth wide open and her eyes wide; the dentist, a man in a white tunic with a mask under his chin, leans over her with a small mirror.

a2-u5-l11#nevidim-dobre.picture: In the Šimkos' kitchen, babka Helena tries to thread a needle, holding it at arm's length and squinting; she can't see the eye of it. Her glasses lie on the table beside her.

a2-u5-l11#choice-pan-kovac-nepocuje.picture: At the porter's lodge, Emma says something through the window; pán Kováč leans towards her, cupping a hand behind his ear and frowning: he can't hear well.
